 Trinity Airways offers Double 11 deals on Taiwan-Korea routes
 Copied! 
 Airlines and Aviation 
 Taiwan 
 Selected, reviewed and published by Siriporn Sachamuneewongse , Editor Adapted from official press releases using AI tools. How we use AI 
 November 13, 2026 
 Trinity Airways (formerly t'way) Boeing 737-MAX 8 taking off at Gimpo International Airport in Seoul, South Korea. Parkdolly / Shutterstock.com 
 Trinity Airways, formerly known as T'way Air, is marking Taiwan's Double 11 shopping festival with special offers on its Taiwan–Korea routes. Customers who book by 30 November 2026 can receive discounts of up to 15% with the promo code NOV26. Additional savings are available through exclusive booking coupons.
 The airline operates seven routes between Taiwan and South Korea. These include Taipei Songshan–Seoul Gimpo, Taoyuan–Jeju and Taoyuan–Daegu. From Kaohsiung, the airline serves Seoul Gimpo, Incheon and Jeju, while Taichung connects with Seoul Incheon.
 The promotion includes a TWD 1,111 early-bird coupon for bookings exceeding TWD 8,000. The offer applies to all routes except Taipei Songshan–Seoul Gimpo, for travel between 1 February and 27 March 2027.
 Regular coupons offer TWD 300 off the Taipei Songshan–Seoul Gimpo route and TWD 600 off other routes. Both discounts apply to bookings exceeding TWD 6,000.
 Trinity Airways rebranded on 10 September 2026 and is introducing a Selective Service Carrier (SSC) model. The approach allows the airline to tailor its services to individual routes and customer preferences. It aims to maintain competitive fares on shorter flights while offering enhanced services on longer routes.
 CEO Sangyoon Lee said: "Through our SSC model, we will continue to refine our services whilst prioritising safe and reliable operations."
 Trinity Airways currently serves 60 destinations worldwide and continues to expand its network.
